sources.title: Boda Data newsroom: 'Boda Data at the 2026 China Computing Power Conference' (博大数据参加2026中国算力大会：让算力更好支撑智能，让智能真正转化为生产力), 14 September 2026
sources.attribution: 博大数据 (Boda Data), company newsroom
sources.summary: Operator newsroom item dated 14 September 2026 (日期：2026-09-14) on Boda's participation in the 2026 China Computing Power Conference in Langfang (11-13 September). In its own words the company says that Langfang is an important node for it, that it currently has several projects there, and that its Langfang No. 2 intelligent computing base serves leading Internet enterprises with customised services (廊坊二号智算基地面向头部互联网企业提供定制化服务). In the same passage, its Langfang No. 1 base provides build-and-maintain services for JD.com, and further projects are being planned. The statement is present tense and names the Langfang No. 2 base, but no phase, building, capacity in use or opening day. Phase 2 of the base was still in pre-production validation on 9 October 2026 (existing Atlas record), so the services described on 14 September are those of the Phase 1 buildings, which the operator's 21 July 2026 WAIC item already describes as serving leading Internet clients.
sources.date_semantics: Published 14 September 2026 by the operator. Present-tense statement read as the operator's confirmation that the Langfang No. 2 base was serving customers on the publication date. It is not an opening day, an inspection day or a capacity measurement.

sources.title: Digital Realty blog: 'Hong Kong data centers: HKG11 and the gateway to Asia's digital core' (13 October 2026)
sources.summary: Digital Realty's own blog post, dated 13 October 2026 on the page (field_publish_date 2026-10-13), states in its FAQ that 'Digital Realty operates two data centers in Hong Kong': HKG10 in the Tseung Kwan O cluster and HKG11 at 11 Kin Chuen Street, Kwai Chung, which 'spans 228,000 square feet (21,182 m²) across 12 stories, with eight dedicated data hall floors'. The body calls HKG11 'our second Hong Kong data center' and describes HKG10 in Tseung Kwan O and HKG11 in Kwai Chung together providing geographic redundancy for customers. It lists HKG11 certifications (SOC 1-3, PCI-DSS, ISO 9001, 14001, 27001). It gives no capacity in MW, no opening date and no construction work.
sources.date_semantics: Published 13 October 2026 (date shown on the page and in its field_publish_date). The present-tense operator statement is used as the operating observation for HKG10 and HKG11 on that day; it is not an opening, inspection or commissioning date. Market statistics quoted in the post come from third parties and are not used.

literal_page_quotes.literal: Digital Realty operates two data centers in Hong Kong.
HKG11 is at 11 Kin Chuen Street, Kwai Chung, in the New Territories.
HKG10 in Tseung Kwan O and HKG11 in Kwai Chung together provide geographic redundancy

sources.title: Digital Realty facility page: HKG11 Data Center, 11 Kin Chuen, Kwai Chung, Hong Kong
sources.summary: Digital Realty's HKG11 page describes 'our HKG11 data center in Hong Kong's Kwai Chung cluster', gives the address '11 Kin Chuen, Kwai Chung, Hong Kong', a 12-storey building of 180,500 ft² (16,800 m²), N+1 UPS and cooling redundancy and SOC/PCI/ISO certifications, and offers tours. Its page data also carries a map marker (field_latitude 22.36997, field_longitude 114.12935). The 16,800 m² building size differs from the blog's 21,182 m²; both are kept source-specific.
sources.date_semantics: Undated facility page retrieved 2026-10-26 (sitemap lastmod 2026-08-19); used for address, identity and specifications only, not as the status observation.

sources.title: Digital Realty press release: 'Digital Realty Launches Development of Second Data Centre in Hong Kong' (1 July 2020)
sources.summary: The 1 July 2020 release announces a purpose-built Kwai Chung facility 'to be named Digital Realty Kin Chuen (HKG11)', a 12-floor, 21,000 m² building expected to deliver up to 24 MW of critical IT capacity, and states that Digital Realty entered Hong Kong in 2012 by acquiring Digital TKO (HKG10) in the Tseung Kwan O industrial estate, capable of up to 18 MW of critical IT capacity. It bridges the facility codes to the Kin Chuen and Tseung Kwan O industrial-estate properties.
sources.date_semantics: Dated release of 1 July 2020 (PR Newswire dateline). Historical identity context only; its capacities and mid-2021 readiness target are 2020 statements and forecasts and are not used as status.

sources.title: Lands Department lot boundary via CSDI: Kwai Chung Town Lot No. 495 (LotCSUID 553000495), HK1980 Grid
sources.publisher: Lands Department, Government of the Hong Kong SAR (CSDI Portal)
sources.summary: The CSDI lot layer returns a single polygon for Kwai Chung Town Lot No. 495 with Shape__Area 2,781.01 m2 in EPSG:2326 (about 56 m by 93 m, 40 vertices); the same ring is returned by a point-intersection query at the 11 Kin Chuen Street address point. Each vertex is transformed once with pyproj 3.7.1 / PROJ 9.5.1 (Hong Kong 1980 to WGS 84 (1), stated accuracy 1.0 m) and rounded to seven decimals; the planar centroid of the transformed ring, [114.1290093, 22.370335], lies inside it and is reproduced to under 1e-7 degrees by the Geodetic Survey transformation service.
sources.date_semantics: Undated cadastral service response retrieved 2026-10-26; locator only, not a status observation.
